name: Pathfinder 1e
author: Paizo Publishing (PRD)
description: Pathfinder 1st Edition - d20 OGL rules set.

attributes.label: DEX
attributes.description: Hand-eye coordination and fine motor control.

attributes.label: CON
attributes.description: Physical toughness and resistance to damage.

attributes.label: INT
attributes.description: Reasoning ability, memory, and skill points.

attributes.label: CHA
attributes.description: Force of personality and social presence.

savingThrows.label: Fortitude
savingThrows.description: Resists physical threats - poison, disease, energy drain.

savingThrows.label: Reflex
savingThrows.description: Avoids area effects - explosions, traps, breath weapons.

savingThrows.label: Will
savingThrows.description: Resists mental effects - charms, compulsions, illusions.

conditions.label: Blinded
conditions.description: -2 AC; loses Dex bonus to AC; -4 Perception vs sighted; 50% miss chance.

conditions.label: Confused
conditions.description: Acts randomly each turn per the confusion table.

conditions.label: Dazed
conditions.description: Can take no actions for one round; AC unaffected.

conditions.label: Dazzled
conditions.description: -1 attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks.

conditions.label: Deafened
conditions.description: -4 initiative; 20% arcane spell failure for verbal spells.

conditions.label: Entangled
conditions.description: -2 attacks, -4 Dex; half speed; Concentration check to cast.

conditions.label: Exhausted
conditions.description: -6 Str and Dex; half speed; becomes Fatigued after 1h rest.

conditions.label: Fatigued
conditions.description: -2 Str and Dex; cannot charge or run.

conditions.label: Flat-Footed
conditions.description: Loses Dex bonus to AC; can't make attacks of opportunity.

conditions.label: Frightened
conditions.description: Flees from source if possible; -2 attacks, saves, checks while source visible.

conditions.label: Grappled
conditions.description: -4 Dex; -2 attacks vs non-grappler; must succeed CMB check to cast.

conditions.label: Helpless
conditions.description: Paralyzed, sleeping, or bound; effective Dex 0.

conditions.label: Invisible
conditions.description: +2 attack bonus; opponents lose Dex bonus to AC.

conditions.label: Nauseated
conditions.description: Can only take a single move action per turn; no attacks, spells, or items.

conditions.label: Panicked
conditions.description: Drops held items; flees blindly; -2 saves while in flight.

conditions.label: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Frozen in place; helpless; attackers make a melee touch attack.

conditions.label: Petrified
conditions.description: Turned to stone; unconscious; immune to most effects.

conditions.label: Pinned
conditions.description: Immobile; helpless; cannot speak clearly or cast spells with verbal components.

conditions.label: Poisoned
conditions.description: Suffering ongoing poison track effects.

conditions.label: Prone
conditions.description: -4 melee attacks; +4 AC vs ranged; -4 AC vs melee.

conditions.label: Shaken
conditions.description: -2 attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.

conditions.label: Sickened
conditions.description: -2 attack and damage rolls, saves, skill and ability checks.

conditions.label: Staggered
conditions.description: Only one move action or standard action per round (not both).

conditions.label: Stunned
conditions.description: Drops everything held; can't take actions; -2 AC; loses Dex bonus to AC.

conditions.label: Unconscious
conditions.description: Helpless and unaware of surroundings.

conditions.label: Dead
conditions.description: HP below negative Constitution score.
